verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs say the Agent Platform can be turned on or off for top-level groups on GitLab.com and for whole instances on Self-Managed (gitlab-docs-63, gitlab-docs-49). Its AI governance docs say you can configure Allow, Ask, and Deny policies for agent tools, enforced at execution time for all connecting clients (gitlab-docs-44). This is backed by human-in-the-loop approvals (gitlab-docs-40) and per-agent tool selection (gitlab-docs-57). Missing for 10: on/off control below top-level groups (subgroups) is not shown, the docs don't say whether tool policies are scoped per group or per instance, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
